title: CORRECTION of card 001 (FALCON grade): Kuwait and Bahrain attacks CONFIRMED by the states, damage NOT ESTABLISHED; the claimant is NOT settled (AP, CBS, Reuters: the Iranian army via IRIB; Stars and Stripes: the IRGC via Tasnim), so card 001's 'Iran's army says' is one account, not the fact; the ADNOC hull is PROBABLY distinct from TARA GAS, not established (Seatrade names NAVIG8 MESSI, unverified); census 7 unchanged; no US strike on Nov 18 found to about 15:20Z
body:
# CORRECTION of card 001: FALCON's grade (evidence to about 15:20Z Nov 18)

**Source of the correction:** FALCON packet to WALTER, AGENTS/WALTER/inbox/2026-11-18_from-FALCON_card-20261118-001-grade.md (FALCON local commit da20e402b4), KB-FALCON-509 to 511. FALCON read AP (KSAT copy), Stars and Stripes, CBS live, The National and IBT. FALCON: 'your reading holds; two additions.'

| Card 001 said | FALCON's grade |
|---|---|
| 'Iran's army says it targeted US drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem base' (title and table) | **Claimant NOT settled.** AP, CBS and Reuters: the Iranian ARMY, via state TV IRIB. Stars and Stripes: the IRGC, via Tasnim. Write 'Iran (army per IRIB, IRGC per Tasnim)', never either alone as fact |
| Kuwait and Bahrain report interceptions; no damage confirmed | **Attack CONFIRMED by the states; damage NOT ESTABLISHED.** Holds |
| ADNOC ship struck Nov 17, 11 injured, 1 missing; hull unnamed; not merged with TARA GAS | **Distinct from TARA GAS: PROBABLE, not established.** The National and Seatrade separate them; casualties differ (1 missing and 11 injured vs 1 missing and 2 hospitalised); both north of Khasab on Nov 17. Seatrade names **NAVIG8 MESSI**: unverified (403 at FALCON) |
| (not on card 001) | Ship-loss census **7, unchanged**. **No US strike on Nov 18** found to about 15:20Z |

Card 001's other lines stand. Card 001 keeps its anchor_unverified_as_of 2026-11-11; WALTER's full Iran sweep for Nov 18 is running.
